verdict.rationale: Chroma is an API-first database. A published OpenAPI spec exists [chroma-probe-2], and the core operations (adding data, embedding, querying, full-text, regex and metadata filtering) are documented as SDK/API calls [chroma-docs-2][chroma-docs-3][chroma-docs-4]. Forking is billed per fork request [chroma-docs-26], and an official CLI [chroma-docs-23] and MCP server [chroma-docs-19] let users browse collections and work with Cloud DBs outside any UI. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of API/UI parity, evidence that Cloud account-level tasks (database creation, API keys, billing, team settings) can be done via API, independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
